project.title: Sunflower Bowl / Tray v0.2.0

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the final bed-contact plane
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X right in the product top view
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps Step1X source coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: The visible body shall retain the selected soft sunflower petal and central seed-disc character.
The manufacturing derivative shall preserve the registered Step1X flower body and add only the owner-confirmed 80 × 6 mm disc foot as parametric geometry.
requirements.verification: registration report, mesh audit and exact-profile slice

requirements.statement: The central open tray depression shall remain free of generated closures and hidden pockets.
requirements.verification: sections, top view and physical dry-item test

global_style.summary: one coherent soft sunflower tray with rounded petals and readable medium-scale seed detail
global_style.generation_material: matte warm yellow clay with broad diffuse lighting
global_style.detail_hierarchy: tray silhouette first, petals second, sparse printable seed relief last

assembly_sequence: Generate and preserve the raw Step1X geometry proposal.
Register uniformly to the 200 mm product envelope and convert +Y-up to +Z-up.
Do not repair, simplify or parametrically reconstruct the Step1X flower body.
Create the owner-confirmed 80 × 6 mm disc foot and Boolean-union only that foot.
Audit protected-region preservation and slice the single derived body; no physical assembly is required.

decision_log.topic: Exclude all prior AI meshes and the old 3MF from the new derivative chain.
decision_log.current_basis: The files predate the Step1X cleanup and have no auditable run manifest.
decision_log.evidence_needed: New Step1X run at or after f00dd46.

decision_log.topic: Qualify the final support footprint, petal-edge comfort and loaded tilt stability.
decision_log.current_basis: Only digital and nominal evidence exists.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Full prototype printed on the recorded process and measured physical test results.

decision_log.topic: Add the real-print disc foot parametrically without repairing the Step1X body.
decision_log.current_basis: Owner instruction plus old Anycubic 3MF metadata establishing a nominal 80 × 6 mm disc.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Foot parameters, Boolean report and protected-region comparison.

components.name: Step1X sunflower appearance preform
components.role: visible one-piece flower form and tray massing

manufacturing.method: FDM after uniform registration and foot-only Boolean union
manufacturing.material: SUNLU PETG Black digital baseline; final yellow material unresolved
manufacturing.orientation: parametric disc foot on the bed

checks: provisional height at or below 65 mm
no thin or detached petal tips

image_to_3d.positive_prompt: One coherent low shallow sunflower tray with twenty broad softly curved petals, a broad accessible central depression and sparse raised sunflower seed detail, shown as matte warm yellow clay.
negative_spaces: the central depression remains open from above

landmarks.meaning: project centre on final bed plane
positive X silhouette extremum after registration
positive Y silhouette extremum after registration

components.name: Parametric 80 × 6 mm disc foot
components.role: owner-confirmed positive foot geometry and final bed placement
functions: provide the 80 mm planar bed contact
provide the 6 mm owner-confirmed foot thickness

manufacturing.method: printed positive cylinder Boolean-unioned to the Step1X body
manufacturing.orientation: 80 mm circular face coincident with the project XY plane

joining.method: positive disc Boolean union with 5.9 mm nominal overlap and 0.1 mm pre-registration protrusion

requirements.load_or_flow: self weight and lightweight dry contents only

keepouts.purpose: conservative proxy for the open central tray depression; no base fill may close it
protected visible upper region outside the underside edit band

validation.method: run plan_hybrid_design.py and review authority/interface matrix
validation.acceptance: one authority per dimension and no unresolved identifiers

validation.method: compare the registered Step1X body and footed result outside the declared cylindrical foot ROI
validation.acceptance: outside the foot ROI only the documented rigid 0.1 mm Z registration is measurable

validation.method: Step1X intake plus registered mesh audit and clay renders
validation.acceptance: one coherent watertight component with accepted silhouette and open depression

validation.method: bounds, bed contact, sections and protected-region review
validation.acceptance: only the underside edit band changes and the support plane is continuous

validation.method: Anycubic Slicer Next exact-profile run and layer review
validation.acceptance: successful G-code with declared build-plate-only tree support, no floating-region warning and peak-flow analysis at or below 13.3 mm3/s

validation.method: full prototype rocking, loaded tilt, dry-item handling and edge inspection
validation.acceptance: all recorded physical criteria pass before print-candidate or release approval
